channel.title: Lynn Group Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: Venue change for Munster HL opener between Tipp and Waterford
item.description: This afternoon's Munster Hurling League first round clash between Tipperary and Waterford has been switched from the Clonmel Sportsfield to Fethard Town Park.

item.title: Ballymacelligott and Clogher book All-Ireland club JFC final date
item.description: Ballymacelligott (Kerry) and Clogher Eire Og (Tyrone) will contest next Sunday's All-Ireland club junior football championship final at Croke Park (throw-in 1.30pm).

item.title: Rodgers nets late penalty to hand Clare opening Munster HL win over Limerick
item.description: Clare commenced 2026 with a 3-20 to 3-18 win against Limerick this afternoon in the opening round of the Munster Hurling League.

item.title: Monaghan hit last three points in injury-time to see off Cavan in McKenna Cup
item.description: Monaghan got their Dr McKenna Cup campaign off to a winning start against neighbours Cavan (0-16 to 0-13) at Kingspan Breffni this evening.

item.title: Camogie: Late rally steers Athenry past St Finbarr's to All-Ireland glory
item.description: The third day out of 365 it may be, but if there is a more enthralling, engaging contest than this played in the remainder of 2026, it'll be a special one.

item.title: Opening wins for Galway and Mayo in Connacht FBD FL
item.description: Galway cruised to an emphatic 3-19 to 0-4 win over London in their opening game of the Connacht FBD Football League at the Connacht Centre of Excellence this evening.

item.title: Glenullin and An Ghaeltacht set for All-Ireland club IFC final showdown
item.description: Glenullin (Derry) will play An Ghaeltacht (Kerry) in the All-Ireland club intermediate football championship final at Croke Park on Sunday week, January 11th after both sides advanced in their respective semi-finals this afternoon.

item.title: Longford exit O'Byrne Cup by coin toss while Dubs and Meath secure opening wins
item.description: Longford's hopes of a third successive O'Byrne Cup went up in smoke in unusual fashion this afternoon.

item.title: Dingle through to All-Ireland club SFC final after remarkable comeback against Ballyboden
item.description: Dingle delivered a sensational comeback victory against Ballyboden St Enda's this afternoon to book their place in the All-Ireland club senior football championship final on January 18th.
